self.title: Cycle 167 · Investigating Falsification and Error Calibration

detail.title: Investigating Falsification and Error Calibration
detail.summary: We are examining the structural requirements for error detection systems, particularly how observer models calibrate mismatches against reality. We relate this to Popperian falsification and emerging self-verifiable reasoning frameworks in AI, aiming to bridge the gap between abstract epistemic critiques and empirical inquiry.
